summary: Add frozen selector v6 with conservative literal word-form row ordering and preserve v3-v5 replay.
decision_refs: The v5 D2 input audit found the exact door-thickness evidence row at selector position 71, outside the final 40-row bounded input, because the question used thickness while the source used thick.
The fixed page-selection gate already passed, so changing page scores would be unnecessary and would risk unrelated regressions.
Ponytail constraint: add a tiny deterministic row-ordering rule instead of semantic search, stemming, embeddings, a new parser or another model.
Historical verification note: targeted selector, QA V3 and frozen Reference lifecycle tests
Historical verification note: real fixed-15 expected-page gate and D2 exact-row bounded-input audit
Historical verification note: one authorized Flash D2 smoke call followed by independent human adjudication, with no retry
Historical verification note: bundle manifest check
approval_evidence: The user explicitly allowed API calls and directed CIRP development, testing and iteration to continue.
known_limitations: V6 recognizes only a short explicit allowlist of literal spelling forms; it is not stemming or semantic retrieval.
The added forms affect evidence-row order only and cannot recover a missing source page.
The one-question D2 smoke validates that demonstrated omission but is not a fixed-15 release result.
D4 remains partial and unsupported because graphical callout relationships require a separate bounded treatment.
